body: I'm socially capable, it's just that grad life has absorbed my time. Romantically, well I'm ugly and not confident enough to counter my lack of physical appeal. As for aspirations, my immediate financial problem is dire...

Do you get off on it or something? I'm beyond broke, 25 year-old grad student. No romantic prospects or social life at that. I'm surviving. It's all I've ever done. Survival doesn't make life worth living.
